title: Travis Kelce Is Just Another Swiftie Liking Videos of Taylor Swift at the Knicks Game on Instagram
summary: The tight end missed the game due to Chiefs training, so he caught up online like the rest of us.
contentText:
Taylor Swift fans were loving all the content that came out of her attendance at the New York Knicks vs. San Antonio Spurs game on Wednesday (June 10) — including her biggest supporter, Travis Kelce .

Related

Travis Kelce Defends Chugging Beer at Knicks Game ‘Date Night’ With Taylor Swift & Addresses Whether He Fell Asleep

Here’s Everything We Know About Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Wedding So Far

Watch Taylor Swift Join in on the Raucous Celebration at MSG After the Knicks’ Game 4 Win

Though the Kansas City Chiefs tight end is often by his famous fiancée’s side at sports games, this time, the pop star was with Mariska Hargitay and Alana and Este Haim as she watched game four of the NBA finals courtside at Madison Square Garden. That means Kelce had to catch up on all of the excitement on social media with the rest of the Swifties, and he showed his vicarious enthusiasm by liking a number of videos of Swift enjoying the game on Instagram.

One of the clips he “liked” showed Swift taking her seat in MSG, with ESPN shouting out her punny “Stevie Knicks” shirt in the caption. Another shared by GQ Sports shows the 14-time Grammy winner saying “Hey!” to the camera as Alana cheers, “Go, Knicks!”

He also gave his stamp of approval on a SportsCenter video of Swift dancing after the Knicks made a basket, captioned, “Taylor’s having so much fun.”

The game — which ended with the NYC team winning 107-106, now just one victory away from the NBA championship — comes midway through minicamp training for the Chiefs. Kelce did get the chance to catch a Knicks game with Swift a few weeks prior, although he was rooting at the time for his home team, the Cleveland Cavaliers.

“Getting Tay back to Cleveland and showing her my roots is always something I love doing,” he said on New Heights afterward. “This wasn’t me trying to persuade Taylor into being a Cleveland sports fan with me. This was me just having a fun date night, knowing I love going to basketball games. We actually tried to go to a game in New York, but I was stuck in Kansas City. I love bringing her into the sports world that I appreciate.”
